about: THE CARDS' RULES AS THE GAME READS THEM (the rulings of 7 October 2026, Design/DECISIONS.md 10 and 12). Written by Bake/content/card_rules.py: do not edit this file, edit Bake/content/card_rules_overrides.json and run the script. An ordinary card left unanswered waits ordinary_hours of running clock and then takes an option by itself; a pressing card waits its own 'hours', and where 'holds_ship' is true the ship makes no way meanwhile. 'take': the options to try, by their keys, in order; the first that can be chosen on the day is taken. The whole rows, with who speaks and the pictures, are in Bake/content/out/card_rules_793.json.
